# r/MkeBucks (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the Milwaukee Bucks stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Milwaukee Bucks in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #50 Tyler Herro 57.4
- #65 Ryan Rollins 55.7
- #104 Kel'el Ware 51.9
- #131 Jaime Jaquez Jr. 48.6
- #148 Myles Turner 47.4
- #213 Caris LeVert 43.0
- #248 A.J. Green 41.3
- #272 Brayden Burries 40.1 (rookie)

Rookies start from a draft-slot prior. GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
